## What changed

- kmctl and kmaudit as two workspace packages, with per-package releases (#53)

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.13.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.13.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.12.2...v0.13.0
